name: BrowserMCP
description: An MCP server that provides AI assistants with full control over a real browser session via a Chrome extension, supporting 36 tools for navigation, data extraction, and DOM manipulation. It bypasses bot detection by utilizing the user's active browser session, including cookies, authentication tokens, and installed extensions.
